messages.subject: Cubic splines in lavaan
parts:
Hi all,

I am wondering if anyone has used cubic splines (or restricted cubic splines) to model nonlinear effects in lavaan? In the model of interest, both the continuous exposure variable and the outcome variable are observed, not latent.

Thanks,

Steve

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Cubic splines in lavaan
parts:
Steve

I havent work with cubic splines, but I do a lot of work with growth models. There are plenty of nonlinear effects that can be estimated with the similar framework as growcth curves, by adjusting what values are used to fix the factor loadings of the growth factors. Do you have a specific equation that defines these splines?

You can see multiple examples of nonlinear effects in SEM in Grimm, K. J., Ram, N., & Estabrook, R. (2016), chapters 9, 10, 11 and 12



Grimm, K. J., Ram, N., & Estabrook, R. (2016). Growth Modeling: Structural Equation and Multilevel Modeling Approaches.
